card.title: CROMWELL Mk IV
card.text: When an enemy unit is pinned, Suppress it.
card.flavorText: The Cromwell was a British Cruiser tank used during WWII by the British Army. The Mk IV variant had a crew of 5 (commander, gunner, loader/radio operator, driver, front gunner), 76 mm front armor and 20 mm armor at the back, a main armament of a QF 75 mm gun (6 Pounder) Mk V ROQF and a secondary armament of 2 x 7.92 mm Besa machine guns. The British Army started to use the Mk IV in 1943, but it first saw action during the Battle of Normandy in 1944 and later in Operation Market Garden. The tank had less firepower than similar sized German tanks, but the reduced thickness in armor made it more fast and maneuverable but at the same time more vulnerable. The Cromwell Mk IV became the most produced variant, with 1,935 tanks manufactured.
